scientific_question: Does the bounded C0 first-linear KSP breakdown primarily present as severe conditioning/scaling, as Krylov reported-vs-true residual-fidelity loss without matching conditioning deterioration, or as a coupled numerical failure?

observability_only_delta.reason_for_absent_jacobian_test: Issue46 has already established the augmented Jacobian on the accepted DS reference; EVR3 should not spend observation budget re-running the historical WP-sensitive Jacobian comparator.

required_observables: reported KSP residual at every observable iteration
true residual at every observable iteration
residual-separation ratio and first threshold crossing at ratio >= 1e6
preconditioned-operator extreme singular-value estimates and max/min proxy where PETSc reports them
MOOSE automatic scaling factors if emitted by the unchanged verbose/scaling configuration
KSP identity, PC identity, KSP termination, PC failure reason, nonlinear termination

interpretation_rules.restart: chronology only; no causal attribution from iteration modulo restart
interpretation_rules.singular_values: conditioning proxy only, not an exact global condition number; after a GMRES restart PETSc estimates reflect the current restart cycle, and the smallest estimate can be inaccurate before convergence
interpretation_rules.H1_conditioning_favored: conditioning proxy or scaling spread deteriorates substantially before or together with true-residual stagnation, and residual-fidelity loss is consistent with that deterioration
interpretation_rules.H2_krylov_fidelity_favored: reported-vs-true residual separation crosses 1e6 while conditioning/scaling observables remain comparatively stable through the onset; restart coincidence alone is insufficient
interpretation_rules.H1_H2_coupled: conditioning proxy/scaling deterioration and residual-fidelity loss emerge together such that neither is separable as the sole cause
interpretation_rules.H3_formulation: do not promote unless new positive structural/closure evidence appears; this observability-only run is not designed to retest the already-trustworthy Jacobian

execution_policy: one run maximum after P1/P2 preflight; no parameter sweep and no immediate follow-up tuning run
post_run_policy: freeze raw log and summary under studies/results or the declared results root, interpret once against these predeclared outcomes, and close the scientific track even if the result remains partially ambiguous; do not authorize a fourth #45 EVR
